title: MIND gateway floorplan and rough RSSI localization
goal: Deliver a deployable one-PC, one-serial-gateway MIND dashboard whose node roster comes from the gateway GTT, whose floorplan and normalized node positions persist on host disk across restart, and whose globally deduplicated wearable incidents receive a bounded rough location estimate from per-observer RX RSSI without changing internal ROOT semantics or claiming precision localization.
scope: Rename user-visible ROOT terminology to GATEWAY while preserving firmware, UART, API, and application ROOT semantics.
Redraw the micro:bit local-root indicator as a recognizable 5x5 G glyph.
Use the sole serial-connected physical device as the dashboard gateway and derive all displayed backbone nodes from that gateway's complete GTT snapshot.
Add host-disk persisted floorplan image and normalized AdvA-keyed node positions with blank-canvas fallback and restart-safe APIs.
Carry each observing backbone's original wearable RX RSSI through a new bounded MIND observed-report record, UART event schema, host API, and dashboard evidence model.
Preserve global event deduplication by wearable plus packet_id24 and derive one rough RSSI-weighted centroid estimate from unique positioned observers.
Render draggable GTT nodes and bounded recent incident estimates on a responsive, keyboard-operable floorplan.
nonGoals: Rename internal ROOT_STATE, ROOT_ACK, ROOT ON/OFF/STATUS, /api/root, mind_root_v1, or TAVRN/MIND root-plane symbols.
Support cloud services, multiple PCs, multiple simultaneous gateway serial connections, accounts, remote administration, or browser-profile synchronization.
Designate a remote gateway without a serial connection or add a network-level remote root command.
Infer parent-child topology edges from GTT, assign fabricated remote node numbers, merge multiple GTT views, or create automatic/default anchor coordinates.
Implement BLE AoA, fingerprinting, Kalman filtering, nonlinear least-squares trilateration, multichannel RSSI aggregation, or production-grade indoor positioning.
Claim meter-level accuracy or set a numeric localization threshold before a calibrated hallway/room dataset exists.
Persist incident history indefinitely or add an external/database service; only one local SQLite layout file persists.
Change the wearable's direct seven-byte schema-v1 advertisement or enlarge the exact TAVRN DATA payload.
Import Firebase, IndexedDB, Room, ARCore, Konva, A*, graph adjacency, zones, or the reference project's runtime dependencies in this slice.
constraints: KISS deployment: one PC, one loopback bridge, exactly one serial argument/gateway, bounded GTT capacity, one local SQLite file, and no external service/database.
Internal ROOT semantics remain unchanged; GATEWAY is presentation language only, and gateway activation still uses the existing root toggle/command targeted to physical owner device 0.

The new forwarded observed-report record remains exactly 10 application bytes and uses distinct kind 0x05; homogeneous backbone upgrade is required, legacy kind 0x02 remains accepted with RSSI unavailable, and real SID8 DATA vectors must pass while 10-byte SID16 submission remains rejected.

The observed-report packer validates the original seven-byte schema including seq before omission; unpack reconstructs seq from packet_id24 and exposes RSSI separately. Magnitude 0 is unavailable; 1..127 converts to signed -1..-127 dBm in UART/API.
Completed Slice A firmware remains allocation-free and bounded with its reviewed resource/stack evidence; Slice E does not reopen or rerun firmware work.

Final gateway identity fails closed unless health has exactly one physical owner device 0, the GTT has exactly one self entry matching gtt.local, and any authoritative root.local equals gtt.local. No gateway entry is synthesized.

Layout state uses explicit absolute --state-dir or absolute nonempty XDG_DATA_HOME/tron-dashboard, otherwise HOME/.local/share/tron-dashboard; directory0700 and dashboard.sqlite3 file0600. SQLite owns atomicity, transactions, and crash recovery; no custom filesystem journal/rollback protocol.

The SQLite database has one singleton layout row: revision, canonical positions JSON, nullable floorplan SHA-256/MIME/width/height/blob. BEGIN IMMEDIATE under one process lock serializes CAS; mutations commit revision and blob atomically. Busy/database errors return storage_unavailable.

Layout coordinates are finite normalized [0,1], keyed by canonical AdvA, capped16, never auto-created. Unpositioned nodes remain staged and excluded from localization. Full-array replacement unplaces omitted nodes; image replacement/removal retains positions.

Floorplan upload admits one in-flight request before body read; encoded Content-Length <=7340032, decoded bytes <=5242880. Pillow==12.3.0 verifies/loads static PNG/JPEG/WebP with <=8192 dimensions and <=64M pixels; MIME/format must match and animation is rejected.
Layout PUT body <=65536; remove POST <=256. Base64 is canonical standard alphabet with no whitespace/data URL, strict validation and re-encoding equality.

All layout mutations reuse strict loopback Host, same-origin/fetch-metadata, JSON media type, duplicate-key, body-size, revision-CAS, one-request-per-connection, and absolute request-deadline protections. Static/floorplan responses use bounded streaming and close FDs/connections.

Localization provider is synchronous and pure with finite positive aspect ratio and discriminated estimated/insufficient/invalid_input output. Aspect-normalized geometry/spread uses the frozen metric.

Localization uses one to sixteen explicitly positioned observers, every additional unique observer complements the RSSI-weighted estimate, path-loss exponent2.0 and canonical strongest-first tie-breaks remain fixed, and collecting/insufficient/ballpark states only are exposed.

Session dedup is bounded: feed/events256, tombstones512 FIFO, processed cursors256, evidence16/event, markers10, counters saturate0xffffffff. Same-observer records retain strongest RSSI and saturating count; cursor replay changes nothing.
Two-second collection starts at first host receipt; late evidence may recompute. Persisted positions, not current GTT freshness, determine eligibility.
Floorplan controls require pointer/keyboard plus semantic node/estimate tables and announcements.
No hardware flash/reset, fleet rollout, PC reboot, or further dependency/config change without explicit approval.

Implementation stays on feat/kiss-wearable-tavrn-dashboard and PR #2. The user-approved D3 dashboard-only localization correction is the sole allowed post-E source mutation; freeze source again after its reviewed local commit.

phases.title: Slice A — observed-RSSI contract, gateway presentation boundary, and G glyph

steps.title: A1 — add exact observed-report RSSI path
steps.target: mind_application wire, ingress/forwarder/inbox/coordinator/log path and docs/tests
steps.action: A firmware code-writer adds distinct kind MIND_REPORT_OBSERVED=0x05 with exact 10-byte payload. A dedicated packer first validates the original seven-byte direct schema including seq==packet_id24 low byte, then writes packet_id24, schema version/event/confidence/accel/mic, and original observer RSSI magnitude; unpack reconstructs seq and exposes RSSI separately. Legacy MIND_REPORT remains valid with RSSI unavailable. The exact observed record is the sole RSSI carrier through retained event, local publication, TAVRN SID8 DATA, root inbox, logger, and mind_event_v2; zero-RSSI or legacy records use v1/null normalization.
steps.validation: Host-native vectors prove exact bytes, kind/length/urgent/source/RSSI bounds, pre-omission seq validation, reconstruction, malformed rejection, and legacy decode. Real TAVRN SID8 encode/decode/root-inbox vectors preserve RSSI; 10-byte SID16 is rejected. Exact UART grammar is `mind_event_v2 now=<u32> root=<hex12> wearable=<u8> packet=<hex6> schema=1 event=<0..5> confidence=<0..100> svm=<0..8000> mic=<0..255> seq=<u8> observer=<hex12> observer_rssi_dbm=<-127..-1> path=<local|tavrn>`; v1 remains unchanged and host API v2 normalizes it to null. MIND/resource/docs suites pass.

steps.title: A2 — redraw the gateway glyph and freeze UI-only terminology
steps.target: mind_ui 5x5 framebuffer plus dashboard visible copy inventory
steps.action: In parallel with A1 where file ownership is disjoint, a code-writer replaces only the local-root 5x5 framebuffer with a recognizable G and updates exact row tests. Inventory every visible ROOT string for later GATEWAY replacement, explicitly excluding firmware/UART/API/internal names.
steps.validation: UI framebuffer tests assert the five G rows, node digits/active-root overlays remain unchanged, audio transition behavior is unchanged, and no internal protocol rename appears in the diff.

steps.title: A3 — adversarial review of Slice A
steps.action: A code-checker reviews wire compatibility, bounded ownership, local versus remote RSSI provenance, logger priority, exact schema framing, mixed legacy behavior, resource impact, and glyph-only UI semantics before Slice B starts.
steps.validation: No blocker/critical/major findings remain; required corrections are applied by a scoped code-writer and all Slice A checks rerun.

phases.title: Slice B — one-gateway bridge contract and durable floorplan state

steps.title: B1 — extend event parsing and add durable layout APIs
steps.action: Replace the rejected custom filesystem journal implementation with a KISS SQLite LayoutStore using Python sqlite3 and one `dashboard.sqlite3` file. Parse mind_event_v1/v2 to mind.api.v2, require one production serial, and enforce fail-closed gateway self identity. Implement the unchanged exact layout/floorplan HTTP schemas. The store uses one RLock and BEGIN IMMEDIATE for revision CAS; one singleton row atomically stores revision, sorted positions JSON, and nullable validated floorplan metadata/blob. Pillow12.3.0 validates uploads. Explicit/XDG directory permissions, database0600, one-request connections, absolute deadlines, request security, bounded image/static streaming, and clean worker shutdown remain.
steps.validation: Tests cover v1/v2 API, one gateway/identity, exact route/schema/error/security/body limits, revision0/+1/no-op/409, concurrent CAS one winner, SQLite close/restart persistence, busy/corrupt/storage error mapping, directory/file modes, Pillow valid baseline/progressive JPEG/PNG/WebP and malformed/animation/bomb/mismatch, upload admission, ETag/304/blob streaming, static nested/symlink/size streaming, deadline/no-post-deadline mutation, and worker/store shutdown. No bespoke transaction-marker tests remain.

steps.title: B2 — adversarial review of Slice B
steps.action: A fresh code-checker reviews the rewritten SQLite-based Slice B for schema compatibility, transaction/CAS correctness, SQLite connection/thread lifecycle, corruption/error handling, image validation, loopback request security, one-gateway authority, bounded streaming, and shutdown. It explicitly rejects reintroduction of custom journal/rollback machinery.
steps.validation: No blocker/critical/major findings; host tests, pycompile, Pillow pin/install docs, and diff hygiene pass. Only then commit Slice B.

phases.title: Slice C — gateway/GTT roster and deployable floorplan HCI

steps.title: C1 — replace serial-node UI with gateway GTT floorplan
steps.action: A frontend code-writer decodes exact mind.api.v2 and layout contracts, treats only physical owner device0 as Gateway, keeps /api/root but changes every visible ROOT string to GATEWAY, removes explanatory copy, and requests only device0 GTT. Roster derives only from a valid complete gateway GTT. Unpositioned GTT entries remain in an explicit staging list outside the map; only pointer/keyboard placement creates persisted coordinates. Add blank/image content-rectangle floorplan, upload/remove, positioned-node drag, unplace/clear controls, optimistic CAS with conflict refetch/reapply, stable refresh, and semantic coordinate/estimate tables. Image replacement retains coordinates and clearly announces the retained mapping.
steps.validation: Tests cover exact schemas, no visible ROOT copy, one gateway unknown/disconnected/off/on/pending, device0-only commands, missing/duplicate/mismatched self fail-closed, no source selector, GTT-only roster, unpositioned staging, three unplaced nodes cannot localize, reordered/stale/departed entries, blank/image frames, upload/remove/replacement, restart, drag/clamp/unplace/clear, keyboard instructions and coordinate values, focus/status announcements, 409 reapply/rollback, stable refresh, responsive semantics, reduced motion, no fabricated edges/numbers/positions, Bun/npm/typecheck/build, and wide/narrow rendered review.

steps.title: C2 — adversarial review of Slice C
steps.action: A code-checker reviews human-computer interaction, gateway authority, GTT-only identity, floorplan persistence races, drag/keyboard accessibility, responsive behavior, state continuity, exact decoder security, and explanation removal before localization integration.

phases.title: Slice D — deduplicated bounded RSSI location estimate

steps.title: D1 — add provider-based weighted-centroid localization and event overlays
steps.target: dashboard event evidence/store, localization module, floorplan integration and tests
steps.action: A frontend code-writer defines the pure discriminated LocalizationProvider contract and WeightedCentroidProvider configured with path-loss exponent 2.0. The provider validates finite positive aspect ratio; geometry, spread, and all error reporting use d_norm=hypot(aspect*dx,dy)/hypot(aspect,1), and normalized doubled area abs(cross(aspect*x,y))/aspect with degeneracy <=1e-6. The reducer owns bounded logical-event deduplication, unique-observer strongest-RSSI evidence, saturating counters, FIFO tombstones, and first-receipt collection deadlines. FloorplanPanel remains the sole layout persistence/mutation owner and publishes only decoded, stale-guarded GET/200 committed snapshots—never draft, optimistic, aborted, or conflicted intended coordinates. App retains only the latest confirmed layout projection and synchronously derives localization through the provider; persisted-position joins remain independent of current GTT authority. At most ten newest floorplan views are shown and only ballpark views render map markers.
steps.validation: Historical D1 validation covered the original minimum-three/strongest-four provider, aspect rejection, normalized geometry/spread, current-GTT disappearance, state capacities, and saturating counters. D3 explicitly supersedes only the contributor threshold/selection/spread behavior.

steps.title: D2 — adversarial review of Slice D
steps.target: complete localization and cross-layer schema diff
steps.action: A code-checker traces one wearable observation from radio RSSI through wire, gateway UART/API, global dedup, coordinate join, and map output. Review numerical stability, overclaiming, body/multipath limitations, bounded state, and late/duplicate evidence behavior.
steps.validation: No blocker/critical/major findings remain; replay fixtures and all cross-layer suites pass, and UI consistently labels estimates as rough/ballpark.

steps.title: D3 — accept one observer and refine with every additional observer
steps.target: dashboard localization provider, presentation, tests, and workplan
steps.action: Change WeightedCentroidProvider so zero positioned RSSI observers is insufficient, one observer produces a ballpark marker exactly at that observer, and every additional retained unique positioned observer participates in RSSI-weighted recomputation. Preserve the reducer's existing deterministic first-16-identity admission bound and strongest-RSSI-per-observer replacement; the provider uses every retained positioned observer, ordering strongest RSSI first with canonical equal-RSSI ties rather than evicting identities. Preserve pure synchronous provider behavior and no precision claims. Generalize leave-one-out normalized spread to two or more contributors; one contributor reports spread unavailable. Geometry warning is false/not-applicable below three and applies only when at least three contributors are present and every triangle is degenerate.
steps.validation: Provider and deployed composition tests prove zero or null/unpositioned evidence is insufficient with required=1; one observer returns its exact normalized position and marker; two observers produce the exact weighted centroid and exact leave-one-out normalized spread; three observers produce the exact maximum-pairwise leave-one-out spread; geometry is not applicable below three and detects three-plus degeneracy; all retained sixteen observers influence output and produce finite bounded spread; input permutations preserve deterministic contributor order and estimate; the reducer deterministically rejects a seventeenth identity while retained observers continue strongest-sample aggregation; UI copy never claims three are required. Dashboard tests/typecheck/build, one-observer wide/narrow render, focused post-D3 review, workplan validation, and no-firmware diff check pass.

steps.title: D4 — review and render one-observer localization
steps.target: D3 dashboard-only diff and real one-observer rendered state
steps.action: After D3 implementation and tests, run an adversarial dashboard-only review of provider/composition/UI behavior and inspect wide/narrow real Bridge renders containing one positioned RSSI observer. Resolve valid blocker/high/medium findings, rerun affected dashboard checks, commit the accepted change, and stop.
steps.validation: No blocker/high/medium provider, composition, copy, or visual findings remain; one observer visibly yields Ballpark at its exact anchor with spread unavailable and geometry not applicable; no host, firmware, hardware, D2, push, or PR work occurs.

notes: Reference architecture reviewed at /home/lucas/AndroidStudioProjects/MyApplication. Its useful seam is the IBleTriangulation-style provider boundary and a shared positioned-anchor model. Its admin web does not perform localization; Android owns BLE/AR fusion. Firebase, IndexedDB, Room, ARCore, Kalman filtering, A*, zones, graph adjacency, and Konva are intentionally not imported.

Floorplan arrangement is a required localization input because positioned backbone observers are the anchors. Full graph adjacency is orthogonal: it is deferred, and GTT hop/freshness never becomes a fabricated edge. Stable AdvA IDs and normalized positions allow a future graph schema or Konva editor without changing LocalizationProvider.
